# Republican support for Trump has fallen as Democrats hold a big lead among enthusiastic midterms voters

David Montgomery-August 18, 2026

According to this week's Economist / YouGov Poll, about one-third (35%) of Americans strongly or somewhat approve of Donald Trump's job performance as president, and 61% disapprove. That's a net job approval of -26, up slightly from -29 last week. [...] Democrats have widened their advantage in the race for Congress. 46% of registered voters say they will vote for the Democratic candidate in the November elections and 39% will vote for the Republican candidate.
